# Uchinchi tomon kutubxonalari va ularning litsenziyalari

| Kutubxona | Versiya | Vazifasi | Litsenziya | Fayl |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| docx (Dolan Miu) | 9.14.0 | DOCX fayl yaratish | MIT | `vendor/docx.iife.js`, `vendor/LICENSE-docx.txt` |
| PptxGenJS (Brent Ely) | 4.0.1 | PPTX fayl yaratish | MIT | `vendor/pptxgen.bundle.js`, `vendor/LICENSE-pptxgenjs.txt` |
| Manrope shrifti | 4.x (@fontsource-variable) | Interfeys shrifti | SIL OFL 1.1 | `fonts/*.woff2`, `fonts/LICENSE-Manrope-OFL.txt` |

Eslatma: ikkala eksport kutubxonasi ichiga ZIP bilan ishlash uchun JSZip kiritilgan (JSZip MIT yoki GPLv3 ikki litsenziyali; bu loyiha uni MIT sharti bilan ishlatadi).
Fayllar npm paketlaridan (`docx`, `pptxgenjs`, `@fontsource-variable/manrope`) oʻzgartirilmagan holda nusxalangan.
